full_name: Iryna Smaznova | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Law Robert G. James Scholar Fellow National University "Odesa Law Academy" (Ukraine)
bio: Trained in jurisprudence and finance, Iryna Smaznova conducts research in legal anthropology. The author of more than 50 publications in her field, she explores the philosophy of media practices and the philosophical and legal aspects of violence and tolerance.
